rows.headline: Cisco shares slide 8% despite earnings beat and stronger-than-expected guidance
rows.prelim_note: Margins criterion: FQ4 non-GAAP gross margin fell to 66.3% from 68.4% y/y and FQ1 FY27 guide of 65-66% signals continued compression from AI-hardware mix; shares fell 8.4% despite a record revenue/EPS beat.

rows.headline: Teledyne to Acquire Varex Imaging Corporation
rows.prelim_note: Capital-structure/M&A criterion: $1.1bn all-cash deal at $18.90/share (~88% premium); Varex shares jumped ~50% pre-market on the news.

rows.headline: Oil Market Report - August 2026
rows.prelim_note: Supply/demand criterion: IEA cut its 2026 global oil demand forecast by a further 510kb/d (to -1.6mb/d y/y) citing the continued Strait of Hormuz closure, widening the projected Q3 2026 deficit to 1.8mb/d.

rows.headline: Stock Market Today, Aug. 11: On Holding Stock Plunges on Worst Day Ever
rows.prelim_note: Revenue/margins criterion: Q2 revenue of CHF850.3m missed the CHF878.4m consensus; FY revenue-growth guidance cut to the low-20s% from at least 23%; shares fell over 20% intraday, the stock's worst day on record.

rows.headline: FTC Stops Sprawling Credit Repair Scheme that Scammed Consumers Out of Nearly $200 Million
rows.prelim_note: Regulatory/legal criterion: a federal court halted a ~$200m credit-repair scam network (17 related entities) at the FTC's request, setting an enforcement precedent for consumer-credit-adjacent operators.

rows.headline: MSCI rejig: Adani Energy, Groww, Laurus Labs, Lenskart shares in; Astral, SBI Cards out
rows.prelim_note: Analyst-expectations/flow criterion: the August MSCI India review adds four names (Adani Energy Solutions, Billionbrains/Groww, Laurus Labs, Lenskart) and drops Astral, Balkrishna Industries and SBI Cards, effective Aug 31, with an estimated ~$1bn in passive flows.

rows.headline: Gold pauses after tame US inflation fuels rally to over two-month peak
rows.prelim_note: Macro/commodity criterion: spot gold near $4,408/oz, its highest since June 5, after July US CPI rose just 0.1% m/m (3.4% y/y); markets cut Fed September hike odds to ~40% from ~50% the day before.
